prologue.heading: Mission: flood relief
prologue.body: Floods have hit the city. Your job: get supplies to as many of 1,200 families as you can, using data, AI, software and the cloud.

tips.text: Each stage has short, timed levels. Beat the clock.
Stuck? A hint appears after 2 misses, the answer after 3.
Every stage feeds the next. Good data makes a better AI.
